convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorNonLagDotMACD custom indicator and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position management. Multi-algorithm entry modes with custom indicator buffers.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator calculation

other_exits: Opposite signal triggers close of existing position via BuyPosClose/SellPosClose permissions

position_sizing.conditional_logic: negative MM value = fixed lot size (e.g. -0.1 means 0.1 lots); positive MM value = fraction of deposit per deal

custom_logic_notes: Four selectable entry algorithms via AlgMode enum: 1) breakdown=MACD crosses zero, 2) MACDtwist=MACD direction change (using 3 bars [0]>[1]>[2] pattern), 3) SIGNALtwist=signal line direction change, 4) MACDdisposition=MACD crosses signal line. Entry signals read from SignalBar (default bar 1=previous completed bar). Close signals are generated simultaneously with opposite open signals when respective BuyPosClose/SellPosClose permissions are enabled. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose with embedded position management logic not visible in this source.
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate ColorNonLagDotMACD custom indicator logic (NonLagDot moving average algorithm) since it is not a standard MACD. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) need reimplementation - they likely contain position existence checks, lot calculation from deposit fraction, SL/TP price computation from pip values, and order execution with deviation. The MM parameter dual-mode (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction) must be handled. SL/TP of 1000/2000 points likely need digit-adjustment for 5-digit brokers (multiply by 10). Signal logic reads from bar index SignalBar=1 by default, meaning it uses the last completed bar for decisions.
